line: Bitcoin fell 2.77 percent on the tape as funding remained calm, while the news brought a federal lawsuit over Tether's power to freeze stablecoin wallets without disclosed legal standards.
small_line: Written from Bitcoin -2.77% on the day, spot ETF net -66.9M USD (07 Oct 2026), Fear & Greed 71 (greed), funding +0.0059% per 8h (calm)

wire_top3.line: Kazakhstan's National Bank will study a tenge-backed stablecoin and tokenized real-world assets with Tether.
Robinhood purchased $25 million in bitcoin for its balance sheet, citing commitment to the crypto sector.
Conduit sued Tether in New York federal court over $2.76M in frozen USDT held without explanation for over a year.
